blocks.text: The Public AI Overview page in AI Security summarizes usage across Gen AI apps and Endpoint AI apps, helping you understand adoption and potential exposure. It includes an app-centric by Apps view, app usage trends over time, and breakdowns by department, top users, and locations to quickly identify where AI usage is concentrated and where activity looks unusual.
The Public AI Overview Page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Quickly see which public AI apps or models are being accessed across the organization.
Understand usage patterns, traffic, and activity volume, to spot rapid adoption or unusual spikes.
Identify the highest-risk public AI services and usage, so teams can focus on what matters first.
Accelerate decisions on what to allow, restrict, or block, and align usage with policy.
Drill down from the overview into service and user details to support security reviews and incident response.

blocks.heading: About the Public AI - Overview Page

blocks.text: On the Public AI-Overview page (Public AI > Overview), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Filter the report for the Last 1 Day, Last 7 Days, Last 15 Days, Last Month, or Last Quarter.
View the following widgets for a quick, at-a-glance summary of your public AI apps:
Total Volume: View the total volume of Gen AI apps used in the organization.
Total Users: View the total number of users of Gen AI apps in your organization. Click Details to view further details on the Usage Insights page.
Upload Volume: View the total volume of data uploaded to Gen AI apps.
Download Volume: View the total volume of data downloaded from Gen AI apps.
Files Uploaded: View the total number of files uploaded to the AI apps.
Gen AI Apps: The total number of Gen AI apps used in the organization. Click See All to view further details on the Public AI Inventory - Gen AI page.
Embedded AI Apps: The total number of embedded AI applications detected across your environment.
Endpoint AI Apps: View the number of Endpoint AI Apps used across the organization. Click Details to view further details on the Public AI Inventory - Endpoint AI page.

By Apps: View the top 5 Gen AI apps used in the organization with policy actions (Allowed, Blocked, or Isolated) distribution for each of the apps in the form of a bar chart. Hover over the bars to view the number of transactions generated by the users. You can filter data for the Gen AI or Embedded apps and by Total Bytes, Transactions, or Users. Click the Details to view further details on the Public AI Inventory - Gen AI page.

App Usage Trends: View the usage trends of the top 5 Gen AI apps in the form of a line chart. Hover over a date to view the AI Apps usage trend for that date. You can filter data by Gen AI or Embedded AI Apps. You can also filter the data by Transactions, Users, or Volume.

AI Usage by Department: View the AI Apps usage drilled down to organization departments or groups in the form of a stacked bar chart. Hover over the chart to view the Gen AI Apps usage by department. You can filter data by Gen AI or Embedded AI Apps. Click View Details to view further details on the Usage Insights page.

Top Users: View the top users and the corresponding AI Apps used. Hover over the line severity bars to view the data distribution across the Gen AI Apps for all the users. You can filter data by Gen AI or Embedded AI Apps. You can also filter the data by Transactions, Users, or Volume. Click Details to view further details on the Usage Insights page.

AI Usage by Locations: View the AI apps usage by location in the form of a bar chart. You can filter data by Gen AI or Embedded AI Apps. You can filter the data by total Transactions or Total Bytes. Click View Details to view further details on the Usage Insights page.
